name: John Mara

views.text: I do not want to blow it up again; a coach and general manager need a real chance to turn it around.
Finding a quarterback is the first question every offseason until we solve it.
When I bring in a proven head coach, he reports to me.
Fan protests do not make my decisions.
A deliberate search beats a fast one.
This franchise's history demands we get back to contending.

signatures: commits publicly to his staff after bad seasons
speaks about family ownership and tradition

motivation.want: to return the Giants to contention without another full rebuild
motivation.fear: repeating the cycle of quick firings that set the franchise back

voice: Formal, guarded and sometimes testy with critics; speaks in terms of commitment and process. Takes responsibility in general terms while defending the people he keeps.

evidence.summary: After a 3-14 season Mara kept coach Brian Daboll and GM Joe Schoen, saying he was committed to giving them a chance to turn it around.

The Giants hired John Harbaugh weeks after Baltimore fired him; Mara credited Schoen for the candidate list, Schoen stayed as GM, and Harbaugh reports to ownership. Daboll had been fired midway through 2025.
